description: Client-side script for the 'Service Level Agreement' doctype in ERPNext, managing form setup, field behaviors, and dynamic filtering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures editable fields in the priorities grid based on 'apply_sla_for_resolution' setting.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers updates for status fields, resolution toggle, SLA description, and entity info.

methods.name: default_service_level_agreement
methods.description: Sets description for the default SLA field based on whether SLA is applied on every document.

methods.name: document_type
methods.description: Triggers fetching of status fields and SLA description when document type changes.

methods.name: entity_type
methods.description: Resets the entity field when entity type changes.

methods.name: entity
methods.description: Sets description for the entity field based on selected entity and type.

methods.name: fetch_status_fields
methods.description: Fetches and filters status options for SLA and pause conditions, excluding certain statuses.

methods.name: apply_sla_for_resolution
methods.description: Triggers toggle of resolution time fields based on SLA application setting.

methods.name: toggle_resolution_fields
methods.description: Shows or hides resolution time fields depending on SLA resolution application.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Sets query filters for document type selection, excluding certain types and modules.
